task: Frozen-model development correctness calibration and review ordering using production .dproj workspaces

manifest.task: Probability the original top word gloss exactly matches a supplied nonempty gold gloss
manifest.validation_scope: Descriptive held-out development sample; word observations are not independent languages
manifest.method_reference: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/guo17a.html (reliability/ECE background; this is empirical stratification, not temperature scaling)
manifest.selection: Unique upstream prefix: learner training, then calibration; disjoint development validation

provenance.implementation_hash_normalization: UTF-8 source text with universal LF newlines

limitations: Single ordered development prefix; no language-level significance claim
Calibration and validation labels are additional supervision, not learner training
Review compares equal sentence budgets; word annotation costs differ and are reported
Error concentration before teaching is not a measured learning gain
Uses A workspace persistence with B teaching/review adapter; no external user-trial claim
No internal-stem-edit experiment or default-model change
